Zoe (Finance): Noticing ~70 invoices where sales tax line is missing in NetSuite but present in Stripe. Customers flagged different tax amounts on statements.
Miguel (Payments): timeline? when did these post?
Zoe (Finance): yesterday morning batch. Stripe shows tax_total field populated; NS rows exported with tax 0.
Sam (Reconciler): quick look  transformer expects `tax.cents` but billing-export started emitting `tax_amount_cents` last week. Missing mapping.
Nora (Ops): replaying events won't fix already posted NS invoices. We'll need a backfill approach.
Miguel (Payments): if we write adjustments, we should create tax adjustment invoices (separate line) instead of editing posted docs. Finance ok with that?
Zoe (Finance): yes, prefer separate adjustment invoices with clear memo. Need GL for tax payable code (2201) and a preview CSV first.
Sam (Reconciler): I'll add mapping and a validation guard to reject events missing tax fields so they go to DLQ. PR incoming.
Nora (Ops): runbook draft: 1) dry-run generate preview CSV, 2) finance signoff, 3) ns-sandbox apply adjustments, 4) prod window apply adjustments and monitor.
billing-bot: Alert: tax-mapping-fix PR queued for deploy; replay paused until manual unpause.
Finance Approvals: please attach estimated $ impact and dry-run CSV.
Miguel (Payments): estimate ~70 * avg $12 tax = ~$840. I'll post CSV to s3 shortly.
Zoe (Finance): thanks. Approvals pending dry-run.
Nora (Ops): scheduling maintenance 01:30 PT tomorrow for the backfill job.
